title: 2006 AMC 8 Problem 2
statement: On the AMC \(8\) contest Billy answers \(13\) questions correctly, answers \(7\) questions incorrectly and doesn’t answer the last \(5.\) What is his score?

solutions.text:
Since the AMC \(8\) only awards \(1\) point for each correct question, Billy will get \(13\) points.

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: On the AMC \(8,\) only correct answers add to the score.
Incorrect and blank answers do not change the number of correct answers.
